subject: maths
question: Tom can do a piece of work in 7 days, whereas Jay can do the same work in 14 days. How long will they take to finish the work if both work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Tom's time = 7 days 

Jay's time = 14 days

**Formula:**

Combined rate = Tom's rate + Jay's rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ Tom's rate = 1/7 of the work per day

 ⇒ Jay's rate = 1/14 of the work per day

Combined rate ⇒ 1/7 + 1/14 = 2/14 + 1/14 = 3/14 of the work per day

Time taken when working together ⇒ 1 / (3/14) = 14/3 days or 4 (2)/(3) days.

**Hence, they will take 4 (2)/(3) days days to finish the work together.**
